assumptions: The declared suite ran under Python 3.13 in a disposable clone containing the exact T-002 dependency checkpoint and T-003 working diff.
The accepted contract stops at the first required gate failure; later unexecuted required gates are recorded blocked-by-failure.

checkpoint_prebinding.method: Harness complete created the local checkpoint. The checkpoint was verified by git show and the task worktree is now clean.

harness_verification.sandbox_backend: Docker Engine 29.8.2; disposable Python 3.13-slim repository clone with the T-002 dependency checkpoint and current T-003 diff applied; git and cryptography installed

residual_risks: The runner intentionally fails closed when it detects a tracked Git submodule or an untracked nested Git repository because Git superproject inventory cannot reliably fingerprint mutable nested-repository contents.
The host Python 3.9 cannot run this shared-verifier suite; validation used the packet-compatible Python 3.13 container.
The local Docker test container is verification evidence, not a CI or production qualification target.

reviewer_results.architecture-reviewer: PASS: both execution-plan origin and family origin policy must bind to task-completion before runner launch; no additional architecture blocker.
reviewer_results.concurrency-reviewer: PASS after withdrawing the initial concern: the accepted spec requires stop-on-first-required-failure and records remaining gates blocked-by-failure.
reviewer_results.independent-evaluator: PASS: no concrete T-003 counterexample. The evaluator noted the duplicate/legacy test proves distinct RUN_NOW plan decisions while execution ordering is exercised by the shared executor; the accepted spec defines fail-fast behavior. Evaluator host Python 3.9 was incompatible, while the exact declared suite passed in the recorded Python 3.13 container.
reviewer_results.security-reviewer: PASS: task-origin binding and VC-015 nested repository/submodule mutation gaps are closed with fail-closed guards and regressions.

summary: T-003 integrates task-completion verification with the accepted shared execution plan. The runner rejects non-task-completion origin, checks whole-worktree mutations including ignored and untracked files, and fails closed on nested Git repositories and submodules. The declared runner suite passed 36 tests; py_compile and diff checks passed. Required independent reviews passed or withdrew a finding after reconciliation with the explicit accepted fail-fast rule.
